row49.decision_12: the identity rule removes the false redundancy at the write and becomes the default of every new journal in v1.1.0; the surprise rule stays behind the flag for the legacy journals; as the lifecycle is coded, an admitted entry under the tribunal's floor is evicted at the next phase, read or not, which on the saliences of row 48 is 1157 of the 1200 near duplicates; that loss is measured by ADR-010 C and decided after it

row50.label: in sample by design (the arms, questions and checkpoints that produced the collision); one draw; by replay, confirmed live once

shapes.none: the base policy: the model's citation surviving the veto stands
shapes.R1: the highest mark: among the window lines at or above the threshold, the cited line becomes the one with the highest mark at full precision; within the tie band the model's line stands if it is among the tied, else the highest in retrieval order
shapes.R2: the key match: among the lines at or above the threshold whose statement parses, the one whose entity equals the question's byte for byte; none or several, the model's citation stands
shapes.R3: abstention on disagreement: when the model's cited line is not the highest marked among those at or above the threshold, abstain
shapes.R4: the composition (exact key first, similarity second): when the question parses, the candidates are the lines at or above the threshold whose statement parses and whose entity equals the question's; none: abstain; one value: the candidate with the highest mark (R1's tie rule); two or more values: abstain; when the question parses under no template: R1

row48_post_hoc_replay.label: post hoc: the shapes were conceived on these files; a consistency check of the machinery; the question texts and the truth are rebuilt from the generator (the files of row 48 carry neither); no decision is computed

hash_note: sha256 of the file's bytes with CRLF normalised to LF, first sixteen hexadecimal characters (the committed form); the files are written in LF by the instruments; the sixteen values equal the ones the founder's consoles printed
